name: mobile-backend
shape: mobile app beside a server, a web app and an ML service

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: the app is self-hosted with docker compose (docker/docker-compose.yml) on the user's own machine; the only hosting config, deployment/ (Terragrunt for Cloudflare), publishes the documentation site, not the app

processes.note: service immich-server, image built from server/Dockerfile; server/bin/start.sh runs server/dist/main.js, which starts the api worker; it also serves the SvelteKit build of web/ from /build/www

the same immich-server container starts the microservices worker in a worker thread (IMMICH_WORKERS_INCLUDE/EXCLUDE choose which); it consumes the BullMQ queues on Redis and runs the in-process cron jobs
service immich-machine-learning, image built from machine-learning/Dockerfile; called by the server over HTTP for CLIP search, face detection and OCR

data.engine: Valkey (Redis), the BullMQ broker and socket.io adapter
local volume UPLOAD_LOCATION mounted at /data (originals, thumbnails, encoded video, backups)
local volume model-cache mounted at /cache (downloaded ML models)

notBreaks.why: browser code: a Svelte store refreshing the job queue view
browser code in the SvelteKit app
an availability check of the ML URLs; if it pauses while the instance is idle nothing is lost
a watcher of the worker's own BullMQ workers, part of the worker that already breaks as queue-worker, not a scheduler of work
cleans up live HLS transcode sessions while any is open and clears itself when the last ends; a lease, not a schedule
writes the OpenAPI spec into open-api/ only when generating it in development
a developer tool that regenerates server/src/queries/*.sql
a CLI for plugin authors, run on their machine
writes a manifest into the model cache; losing it means a re-download on a cold start, not lost data
an idle-shutdown loop started in the lifespan hook that unloads the service after model_ttl; not work after a response, and Cloud Run scales to zero by itself
touches the ANN tuning file in the model cache (open(tuning_file, 'a')); losing it costs seconds on the first inference after a cold start, not data - the same class as sessions/prepare.py

notes: Read docker/docker-compose.yml, server/Dockerfile, server/bin/start.sh, server/src/main.ts (api and microservices workers in worker threads of one process), the repositories that hold BullMQ, cron, socket.io and storage, and machine-learning/immich_ml/main.py. All media lives on local disk under /data (StorageCore and storage.repository.ts), which needs Cloud Storage or a mounted bucket; the microservices worker needs an always-on instance, and its CronJobs (nightly jobs, library scan, version check, database backups) are created with new CronJob<null, null>( in cron.repository.ts. Migrations run at startup in server/src/services/database.service.ts behind a database lock, not as a release step. The Flutter app (mobile/) and its Rust core (native/) run on phones; the immich CLI (packages/cli) is copied into the server image but is a user tool, not a process. The ML service downloads models into /cache, a cache that Cloud Run would refill on each cold start.
